reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Matt T
reviews.text: Mauricio just finished painting a bedroom in my house. It had old school knotty pine boards with many layers of polyurethane over the wood. From the moment I met Mauricio for the estimate, I knew he was my guy as he was professional, knowledgeable, and reasonably priced. It took him less than a week to complete the job and I am beyond pleased with how the room came out and Mauricio. He is an artist! He is trustworthy, punctual, organized, and neat. Not only that, he's a joy to have around and chat with. I highly recommend him!

reviews.author: Susan Myers
reviews.text: Mauricio completed painting the exterior of our home and garage last month and I am only now getting around to posting a review because I have been too busy singing his praises! What we initially considered a much-needed paint job became more of a restoration project [thorough scraping, re-setting nails, caulking, etc] with Mauricio. His price was beyond fair, the quality of his work beyond all expectations. His attention to detail, his work ethic, and his considered recommendations all were validation of a confident, talented, experienced professional. He worked as much "with us" as "for us" and we quickly came to appreciate and admire his eye for color and detail. He was a real pleasure to have in our midst (in fact, we actually miss him!). In our minds, Mauricio is not just the best painter around, he's the ONLY one for us!

reviews.author: Lynne Parks
reviews.text: Mauricio is the best! He painted our complex historic porch. His attention to detail at every stage was gratifying to watch, but I expect nothing less from an artist. Every line and feature was painted with care and I can tell it will last. It looks beautiful. And what a pleasant person to have around! His pricing is very reasonable.

reviews.author: Don Fretwell
reviews.text: Mauricio did a fantastic job removing wallpaper and painting. He also did a wonderful job painting a wrought iron railing and steel doors. Mauricio was very professional, courteous, affordable, and deeply cared about the quality of his work. He sent pictures to keep us updated as we were out of town. I highly recommend him for you interior or exterior painting needs.

reviews.author: June Martin
reviews.text: Our deck was refinished two previous times by two different painters. We recently had Mauricio refinish our deck for the third time, and it has never looked more beautiful than it does now. I believe a key component of the success of Mauricio’s work was his preparation. Mauricio scraped, sanded, vacuumed, washed with a solution to kill black mold, and applied primer where needed. All this was done prior to his putting the final latex paint on the deck rails and oil based stain on the deck floor. Mauricio’s work was meticulous, and we are very pleased with the finished appearance of our deck.

reviews.author: Josh Rhoads
reviews.text: Mauricio did a fantastic job at our house! Excellent craftsmanship, attention to detail and very high quality prep-work. He was pleasant to work with and we enjoyed the process. Really great job in every way!

reviews.author: Kirsten Schneider
reviews.text: Wow!! Mauricio is an *artist*! He painted our exterior aluminium siding, shutters, trim, door and foundation. He made it look completely new! Even taking the time to camouflage the myriad cables on the side of the house. It was a bit tricky as our yard slopes at a steep angle, necessitating him to build a custom platform to paint from. He always showed when he said he would, no hidden costs, a price WAY better than the competitors, and he took his time making it *perfect*. I would recommend him to anyone without hesitation. Quality craftsman.

reviews.author: Jen Huber
reviews.text: I am so glad that I found Mauricio through this Google Page. He is extremely detailed and each room he painted in our house is perfect. He fixed all the imperfections ( and there was a lot in our new to us 100 year old home). I highly recommend Mauricio! You will not be disappointed. Very professional and kind.

reviews.author: Stephen Plumbley
reviews.text: Mr Esperon painted the exterior of our 70 year old home as well as the inside of the sunroom/porch. He was meticulous in the prep work, which was extensive, and for which we are very grateful. There was a lot of very old caulking that needed to be scraped out. He also had to cover some factory-painted metal surfaces (on windows we had replaced) and he made sure that the surface was prepped so that the new paint would adhere and last. His paint work is beautiful and he is very careful to use good quality materials that are right for the job. Aside from his excellence at his craft, he is very considerate, cleaned up the area he was working in at the end of every day, was careful about our foundation plantings, is quiet (except for when he needs to use an electric sander, of course!), communicates his schedule, and is entirely reliable. He even cleaned windows after the painting was finished. His price is entirely fair for the very high quality of his work. His quote was in the middle of those we obtained, but the quality of work is the best I've ever seen done in all our years of home owning. Excellent value. We are already looking at interior projects we would like him to do in the winter.

reviews.author: William Huestis
reviews.text: Hired Mauricio to paint an exterior front door. Excellent job, quick, very neat, polite, patient and clean. We have hired him to do a major interior paint job. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: David Mikesell
reviews.text: We've hired Mauricio to paint several rooms in our house, and have been extremely happy with his work. I would not hesitate to give my highest recommendation for his services.

reviews.author: Todd Nelson
reviews.text: Excellent work at a reasonable price! Lots of ladder work, all done safely. Several layers of old paint required extensive grinding, scraping and associated prep work. A very thorough job that will last!

reviews.author: Joelle Aaslestad
reviews.text: Excellent painting job. Great attention to details. Very neat and clean. Mauricio is reliable and kind. I am very happy about the entire experience!
